title: Cron run log
intro: Every scheduled job run is recorded here: when it started, how long it took, and a sanitized summary of what it did. Failures are highlighted. Runs older than 90 days are deleted by the daily job. Rejected (unauthorized) and disabled job invocations are not recorded. A run still marked Running after 2 hours is shown as Stale / unknown: its process died, or its start was recorded too late to be closed.
